Patch and subpatch delineation for survey-unit mapping

Source: R/fn_patches.R
M2_PER_ACRE.Rd

  1. delineate_patches binarises the probability surface at a suitability threshold and runs a marker-controlled watershed (via WhiteboxTools) to break the suitable network at low necks, with a rook's-case component fallback for cells that drain off-mask, then drops sub-min_area slivers. This is the shared front end for both subdivision levers.

  2. band_subpatches subdivides each oversized patch: it contours the raw surface into fixed suitability bands, finds same-band connected pieces (igraph components), snaps sub-threshold pieces into their highest-band contiguous neighbour (snap_pieces), then geometrically caps any surviving unit still above the maximum size (kcap).

Usage

M2_PER_ACRE

Details

terra + whitebox for the raster/watershed work, igraph for the connected-component and region-adjacency graphs (rook_edges supplies the raster edge list; the greedy band-priority merge in snap_pieces is the one graph step with no library primitive.
